entities.name: Rashida Scalebane
entities.description: Peasant girl from the Mtenda Plains who became a great military leader and dragon slayer in the Mirage War.

entities.name: Kaervek
entities.description: Power-hungry mage who captured Mangara and led an army of undead.

entities.name: Mangara
entities.description: De facto ruler of the region, captured by Kaervek.

entities.name: Jolrael
entities.description: Powerful being manipulated by Kaervek to order beasts and dragons to wage war.

entities.name: Scalebane
entities.description: Rashida's family banesword that became a dragon-slaying weapon.

entities.name: Dragon Mask
entities.description: Artifact whose power let Rashida recover Mangara.

entities.name: Mirage War
entities.description: War on Jamuraa that launched Rashida's career.

events.summary: Dragons attack Rashida's village killing everyone else; she buries the dead and swears a blood oath against dragons.
events.quote: Rashida declared a blood oath against the dragons

events.summary: Rashida amasses an army and fights Kaervek's undead, slaying almost a dozen dragons and becoming a legend.
events.quote: Slaying almost a dozen dragons, Rashida soon became a legend for the common people

events.summary: Rashida leads her army against Kaervek and joins an expedition that recovers Mangara with the Dragon Mask.
events.quote: joined an expedition to recover Mangara

relations.quote: The power-hungry mage Kaervek had captured Mangara
she led her troops against Kaervek's army of undead
